description.en: Cycnorhamphus suevicus inspired living reconstruction: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m whole envelope is an artistic setting. GPIT80 real compressed fossil pixels anchor skull-neck-limb relationships; Bennett2013 original abstract informs synonymy, not fulltext anatomy. Triebold species-labelled commercial skeleton is explicitly interpretive whole-body reference, not a fossil. Restrained jaw opening preserves curved divergent tips and a connected jaw base. Wingmembrane, folded pose, soft tissue and colors artistic. No copied geometry.

scientific_scope.intentional_overlap: Closed body, neck, tail and limb roots deliberately overlap internally at anatomical joints; closed membrane edges coincide with supporting arms and legs. Jaw bases deliberately overlap skull at the hinge; divergent distal tips and the intervening negative space are intentional diagnostic anatomy, not floating breakage. No watertight union claim; two wing forelimbs and two hindlimbs.
